title: Zilber-Pink Conjecture on Unlikely Intersections
exact_target: Are all unexpectedly large special intersections inside a fixed Shimura subvariety controlled by finitely many maximal exceptional pieces?

sources.citation: J. Pila, 'Combining the conjectures of Schanuel and Zilber-Pink', Rend. Lincei Mat. Appl. 36 (2025), 653-670, DOI 10.4171/RLM/1086; accepted 1 July 2025.
The Zilber-Pink conjecture for varieties not defined over Qbar.
